kitDescription: Rapunzel: Pure Grace is an SR Defender whose whole kit hangs off a shared shield she supplies herself: she puts up a team-wide shield at battle start and re-creates it every time she uses her own Burst. While she is shielded and holding a full charge, the whole team gains a permanent 10.41% Attack Damage buff, and each of her full-charge shots heals her for a small amount of her Max HP (at the cost of a small HP drain that also slowly restores the shield). Her Burst temporarily raises her own Max HP and gives all allies 15.24% Attack Damage for 10 seconds. She deals no skill or burst damage of her own — her offensive contribution is her sniper fire plus those two team Attack Damage buffs. In a no-incoming-damage DPS sim, the shield itself, the heal, and the HP drain move no damage directly; only the two Attack Damage lines affect the board.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: all seven kit lines are either FAITHFUL (5) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (2 — the unmodelable charge-hold uptime half of S1-c, shipped gated + permanent as a flagged upper-bound ⚑ with estimate/recipe/tier, and the verbatim-unmodeled S2 HP-drain/shield-restore line). The blind re-derivations converged on 4 of 6 blocks identically; the two divergences are spurious, not findings — S6's self-targeted shield is the conservative header-echo branch that S2b independently ruled against and that the driver's naga-consumer tests behaviorally exclude, and S6's interval-vs-passive L3 trigger is behaviorally identical at scope behind the same self-supplied shield gate. Convergence is real: S5's unmodified assertions (adapted only for harness import paths and a slot-index→slug read) pass 16/0-fail against the shipped override, including the counterfactual gate test (strip shields → 10.41 buff dies) and the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter discriminations, which the driver's own two-B1 liter-decoy fixture also pins. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing line in the S2b set. The same-model residual the owner should spot-check, ranked: (1) the S1-c ~100%-uptime ⚑ — the always-on encoding is the over-credit direction by up to the diluted 10.41% Damage-Up share for the whole team and rests on a play-behavior argument (hold-to-aim between shots), not a measurement; the recorded recipe (focus-recording buff-icon uptime vs the shield icon) is the resolution; (2) the allies-target shared shield — corroborated by two independent agents plus the naga-consumer mechanics, but whether the real shared shield fires ALLY 'shielded' triggers is a structural inference, verifiable with one naga+rapunzel-pure-grace recording. Neither blocks GO: both are documented, flagged, and have concrete measurement recipes.
